text:
Maria P: Heads up — we heard from two hiring managers that a batch of interviewer training invites never went out this morning.
Samir R: which role/team?
Maria P: Platform eng loop — about 12 people. Looks correlated to yesterday's ATS custom-field import.
Alex K: any error logs from the sync? I can check the pipeline.
Maria P: not sure. Samir, I exported the CSV from Greenhouse and saw this header: `interviewer_id,interviewer_ready,timezone`. Some rows have `interviewer_ready` as `yes/no` while our import expects `true/false`.
Samir R: ugh, that would skip the "ready" boolean and the invite job filters them out. We changed the mapping last month to be strict.
Jamie L: can we patch the import to accept `yes/no` and `y/n` for now? We need invites to go today.
Alex K: quick fix: update the transform to cast `/(yes|y)/i -> true` and `/(no|n)/i -> false`. I can push a hotfix to staging and then prod.
Maria P: timeline?
Alex K: 20 min to deploy a container with the transform and run a backfill of the last 24h.
Samir R: I'll re-export the affected team CSV and drop it into the backfill job once Alex is ready.
Reina G: +1 — interviewing starts tomorrow, would appreciate quick turnaround :pray:
ats-sync-bot: [10:05] ATS import job failed: row 234: invalid boolean value "YES" for field interviewer_ready
Maria P: that bot error is the symptom. Samir, can you also add a validation report so we can alert when formats change?
Samir R: yep — adding a CSV schema check and a Slack alert if any field mismatches. Will scope to `interviewer_*` fields first.
Alex K: deployed transform to prod. Backfill started: `job-id: backfill-2100123456-1`.
ats-sync-bot: [10:26] Backfill job backfill-2100123456-1 finished: 12 rows updated, 0 failures.
Jamie L: awesome. Maria, can you confirm invites went out?
Maria P: checked — 11 invites delivered, 1 pending (user has no calendar linked). I'll follow up separately.
Reina G: thanks team!
Samir R: follow-ups: I'll add the validation alert, and open a change note with the recruiting ops runbook so future imports include format checks.
Maria P: adding a small doc to People Ops runbook about the boolean mismatch and the rollback steps.
Alex K: FYI I'll also add a unit test for the transform so different casing/values are covered.
Jamie L: closing loop — we survived the morning chaos :sweat_smile:
Maria P: thx everyone :thumbsup:
